tasks.label: local
tasks.command: & 'C:\Program Files\QGIS 3.44.5\apps\Python312\python.exe' -m sphinx --keep-going -E -a -b html source 'build\html'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Start-Process '${workspaceFolder}\build\html\index.html' } else { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

tasks.label: make_pdf
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $python = 'C:\Program Files\QGIS 3.44.5\apps\Python312\python.exe'; $chrome = 'C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe'; $docs = '${workspaceFolder}\build\html'; $combined = Join-Path $docs '_pdf_reporting_guide.html'; $pdf = '${workspaceFolder}\AQ_eReporting_Guide.pdf'; $staticPdf = '${workspaceFolder}\source\_static\AQ_eReporting_Guide.pdf'; Write-Host '============================================================'; Write-Host '        AQ REPORTING GUIDE - PDF GENERATION'; Write-Host '============================================================'; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'Refreshing the local HTML build...'; & $python -m sphinx --keep-going -E -a -b html source 'build\html'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Sphinx build failed.' }; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'Local HTML build completed.'; if (-not (Test-Path $docs -PathType Container)) { throw 'build\html folder was not created by the local build.' }; if (-not (Test-Path $chrome -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Google Chrome not found at the expected location.' }; & $python '${workspaceFolder}\scripts\make_pdf.py' $docs $combined; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Combined PDF HTML generation failed.' }; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'Creating AQ eReporting Guide PDF with Chrome...'; & $chrome --headless --disable-gpu --no-pdf-header-footer "--print-to-pdf=$pdf" $combined; if (-not (Test-Path $pdf -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'PDF was not generated.' }; if ((Get-Item $pdf).Length -eq 0) { throw 'PDF was generated but is empty.' }; Copy-Item -Force $pdf $staticPdf; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'SUCCESS'; Write-Host 'PDF created at:'; Write-Host $pdf; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'Website PDF updated at:'; Write-Host $staticPdf; Write-Host 'The guide source files were not modified.'
